mission: Prevent benchmark stagnation by continuously measuring, assigning, repairing and retesting every open gap with the maximum safe non-conflicting parallelism supported by the repository.

anti_stagnation_actions.measured_gap: assign canonical owner plus builder/integration/QA/security/value lanes
anti_stagnation_actions.in_progress: require heartbeat/evidence update before threshold; otherwise requeue and escalate
anti_stagnation_actions.fix_ready: run focused and affected regression tests
anti_stagnation_actions.blocked: record blocker owner and recheck cadence; run all unblocked dependencies in parallel
anti_stagnation_actions.passed: refresh before freshness expires or when dependencies/fixtures change

closure_rule: No gap closes because code exists or a bot reports success. Closure requires target evidence, required sandbox/regression/security checks, rollback where applicable and current runtime evidence.

estimate_model.purpose: Produce a planning estimate from the current evidence set without pretending unknown work is known.
estimate_model.moving_target_rule: Current-market, competitor and external-service benchmarks are continuous and can reach current-zero-open-gaps but are never permanently finished.

truth_rule: Aggressive parallelism means maximum safe independent concurrency, not conflicting edits, bypassed approvals, weakened tests or invented completion dates.
